title: Baked Quinoa with Papillote Crust
description: A delicious and healthy baked quinoa dish topped with a flaky papillote crust.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook according to package instructions using quenched water.
In a separate mixing bowl, mix together olive oil and salt.
Cut the flaky papillote into small pieces and mix with the olive oil mixture.
Spread the cooked quinoa on a baking sheet.
Top the quinoa with the papillote mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the papillote crust is golden brown.
